description: Quote how many simulation sessions a run would cost, and roughly what share of your plan it would consume, before committing to it. Free — this never starts a simulation. Use it to size an audience or shorten a study when headroom is tight.

kind.description: What you are about to run.

method.description: Required when kind is 'study' — the research method id.

variants.description: Number of copy variants, for a copy test.

name: aetherya_estimate

sessions.description: Estimated simulation sessions, or null when Aetherya cannot quote this kind up front. Never treat null as zero — read `note` instead.

title: Estimate the cost of a simulation before running it
